name: Material Design 3 Button
summary: shadcn/ui and Tailwind button implementing Google Material Design 3 with ripple, state layers and five official variants.
description: A high-fidelity Google Material Design 3 button built for shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS: a physics-based ripple engine ported from Google's web components, dual-layer key and ambient elevation shadows and mathematically accurate hover and press state layers. Five official variants (filled, elevated, tonal, outlined, text), styled with utility classes and CSS variables and polymorphic through Radix Slot asChild.
contains: Material Design 3 button for shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS
five official variants: filled, elevated, tonal, outlined, text
physics-based ripple engine ported from Google's web components
dual-layer key and ambient elevation shadows
hover and press state layers via CSS variables
